text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 101,258 to 95,091 despite a late recovery, so I should judge progress over longer horizons rather than one month's move.","Doing nothing avoided impulsive trades, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash allocation fit my goals and risk tolerance.","Because I check infrequently, I should use a simple plan for periodic reviews and avoid reacting to short-term volatility."]}
